scope: Bounded dashboard graph validator; browser/runtime acceptance is separately verified by parent.

checks.name: validator accepts valid module and rejects missing module and named export
checks.run: node -e "import('./tools/check_es_modules.mjs').then(({validate})=>{const fs=require('node:fs'),os=require('node:os'),path=require('node:path'),assert=require('node:assert/strict');const root=fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(),'wmm-forge-'));try{fs.writeFileSync(path.join(root,'dashboard.mjs'),'export const value=1;');assert.equal(validate(root).modules,1);fs.writeFileSync(path.join(root,'dashboard.mjs'),'import {value} from '+String.fromCharCode(39)+'./missing.mjs'+String.fromCharCode(39)+';');assert.throws(()=>validate(root),/ENOENT|Missing module/);fs.writeFileSync(path.join(root,'missing.mjs'),'export const other=1;');assert.throws(()=>validate(root),/does not provide an export named/);}finally{for(const file of fs.readdirSync(root))fs.unlinkSync(path.join(root,file));fs.rmdirSync(root);}}).catch(error=>{console.error(error);process.exitCode=1;})"

checks.name: actual dashboard graph and single entry
